items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: I had been to the concert where he played, you know, which uh, a tour which featured Stan Kenton’s Orchestra, special guest, Dizzy Gillespie. Charlie Parker, Frank Rosolino, Erroll Garner played a set, and it was a very exciting concert. And then uh, oh man, about sixty percent of those people came to the club, includin' Charlie Parker. I don't think Dizzy came, but uh, Charlie did. And uh, he played a couple of tunes and then he proceeded to doze off, you know. He was, asked for a chair. It was a rather high…
Do you remember what you played?
